      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds cumulative network traffic accounting across message, connection, and network types directly into CConnman (`src/net.cpp` and `src/net.h`).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "The change adds global lifetime message accounting to CConnman to observe bandwidth consumption without polling peer stats. While it introduces atomic counters to the message send and receive paths reviewed by P2P maintainers, it does not alter peer relay protocols, connection logic, or DoS defenses."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Landed under the `RPC/REST/ZMQ` label, adding a `detailed` breakdown field to the `getnettotals` RPC in `src/rpc/net.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Exposes cumulative message and byte totals in `getnettotals` to satisfy longstanding feature request #26337. Reviewer comments confirm it eliminates existing operator workarounds of polling and aggregating transient per-peer stats for node monitoring dashboards."
    },

      "name": "tests",
